reasons mentioned in the affidavit, delay in filing

condonation no. 3344 of 2019 is allowed.

Admit.
Summon the Lower Court record.

Registry is directed to prepare the paper book 
within three weeks and supply the same to the 
learned counsel for the parties as per Rules.
Reply to the bail application no. 3343 of 
2019 be filed within three weeks.
List thereafter.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) (Alok Singh, J.)

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia,Sri Narayan Singh Dhanik, J.
orders.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Bail Application (CRMA No.3343 of 2019)
On behalf of appellant Anand Kumar S/o Keshoram
In 
Criminal Jail Appeal No.68 of 2019
 
Anand Kumar ….Appellant
 
Versus 
State of Uttarakhand ….…Respondent 
Present:- Ms. Gauri Devi Dev, Advocate for the appellant/applicant. 
 Mr. J.S. Virk, AGA with Ms. Shiwali Joshi, Brief Holder, for the State. 
 
 
Coram:- Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
 Hon’ble Narayan Singh Dhanik, J.
By the Court:-
 Miscellaneous application (IA No.17070 of 2019) 
is allowed. Counter affidavit filed on behalf of State is taken on 
record. 
 
2. This appeal has been filed by the appellant 
against the judgment and order dated 18.05.2018 passed by 
the learned Sessions Judge, Pithoragarh in Session Trial No.03 
of 2017, whereby the appellant has been convicted under 
Sections 302 and 323 of IPC, and has been sentenced to 
undergo life imprisonment under Section 302 of IPC, and to 
undergo six months imprisonment under Section 323 of IPC, 
with default stipulation. The appellant/accused was not on bail 
during trial. 
3. Lower Court record has already been received. 
4. Learned counsel for the appellant has argued on 
the bail application of the appellant. 
5. Heard on the bail application.  2 
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the 
case, this Court is not inclined to grant the bail to the 
appellant. 
7. The bail application moved on behalf of appellant 
stands dismissed. 
8. However, the appellant would be at liberty to 
move an appropriate application for expedite hearing of the 
case. 
(Narayan Singh Dhanik, J.) (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 04.03.2020 
 
Nitesh/
